title: Allocate an Array of Objects
hints: `new Tracked[n]` allocates `n` objects in a row and default-constructs every one of them (`value == 0`), returning a pointer to the first. Index it like an array: `p[i]`.

You cannot pass per-element constructor arguments to `new[]`. Construct first, then loop and assign `p[i].value`. Mind the types: `i` is `std::size_t` and `value` is `int`, so write `first_value + static_cast<int>(i)`. Release with `delete[]`, never `delete`.
